title: Input-bit oracle answer
statement: Let $f$ map bit strings to bit strings, let $h$ be a bit string, and let $i$ be a natural number. The first oracle in the four-language bank associated with $f$, queried on the encoding of $(h,\operatorname{bin}(i))$, returns the bit of $h$ at position $i$, taking the value false when that position is beyond the end of $h$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from bit strings to bit strings
